assertion.statement: For maximal quadratic O and one fixed full orientation tuple, same-place geometric reduction identifies the CM ideal-class torsor with the oriented supersingular embedding torsor, equivariantly and with multiplicity one.
assertion.objects: F imaginary quadratic, O its maximal order, q odd inert, N prime to q*disc(F), CM enhanced curves with labelled O-action, supersingular pairs and their optimal labelled embeddings.
assertion.hypotheses: Every prime of N splits in F; O units are +1,-1; fix CM type, level orientations and the q-adic place. Retain the explicitly listed geometric A052, CM reciprocity and good-reduction functor inputs.
assertion.parameter_range: All prime-power exponents of N, including at2; maximal conductor1 only; q inert and outside the support.
assertion.uniformity: The bijection is exact for each such fixed datum, with no asymptotic discriminant or class-number bound.
assertion.normalizations: Labelled embeddings modulo pointwise isomorphism, not unlabelled conjugate pairs. One q-orientation corresponds to the fixed CM type; inverse Artin convention is uniform.
assertion.limit_order: Fix the actual stage/place and reference point, then choose prime-to-Nq ideal representatives for all classes; no independent place choice for each summand.
assertion.quantifiers: Every class in Pic(O) and every target in the chosen component; the fiber of each fixed underlying supersingular pair is obtained by restriction.
assertion.constants: Multiplicity1; embedding stabilizer order2, hence mass contribution1/2; summing2^(omega(N)+1) tuples gives2^omega(N) with the retained equal-weight formulas.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No assertion for nonmaximal conductors, ramified reduction prime, unsupported D, or both q-orientations in one fixed-type image. Trivial class group,D=1 and larger supersingular automorphism groups are allowed.

available_external_statement: Forward inert-prime supersingular CM reduction in final Gross-Zagier p199; remaining external/foundational inputs are explicit in PREMISES.json.
needed_connection: The geometric reduction of x_D^[a] projects to the same adelic ideal action [a*z0] in the finite weighted sum.
adverse_cases: Every exceptional or outside-domain case is treated in PROOF and the assertion; no automatic acceptance is recorded.
